supportLevel: Unofficial public Microsoft Fabric status mirror based on HTML scraping

active.detailsHtml: Fabric customers may experience issues when using Export to PDF/PPT with MIP labels. As a workaround, users can remove the MIP label on the report to get the export operations working. Engineers are working on identifying the root cause and an update will be provided by 1.30PM PT.
